FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Instructions direct filing as a motion in the original felony case with the circuit court clerk in the county of conviction and require court, county, division and case number to be copied from existing case paperwork.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: Current participant instructions, guidance and adopted legal-track participant actions.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The packet states the $50 application fee, later $250 expungement fee, separate $40 certification request fee and installment request without inventing a waiver outcome. Fee or installment argument is directed to counsel; conditional AOC-026 IFP is not represented as a built component.

legalParticipantActions.name: Copy of the Governor's full pardon
legalParticipantActions.obtainedFrom: The participant's own records, or the Office of the Governor
legalParticipantActions.howToObtain: Use your copy of the pardon. If you no longer have it, ask the Office of the Governor for a copy. It is attached to the application; LegalEase never sees it.

legalParticipantActions.name: Expungement certification from the Administrative Office of the Courts
legalParticipantActions.obtainedFrom: Administrative Office of the Courts, Records Unit
legalParticipantActions.howToObtain: Request it on AOC-RU-009 through the ky_expungement_certification supporting action.

SERVICE.basis: Current participant instructions and adopted route component/actor treatment.
SERVICE.finding: The instructions assign statutory notice to the circuit clerk and expressly tell the participant not to serve the prosecutor. Clerk, Commonwealth/County Attorney and victim-notice roles are not forged into participant-completed fields.

registryNoticeComponent.notes: The clerk performs statutory notice to the prosecuting Commonwealth's or county attorney and the county attorney where judgment was entered, as applicable; the prosecutor handles victim notification. AOC-496.3's clerk-use notice certification is left blank and never assigned to the applicant.

evidence.participantServiceText: you do not serve the prosecutor yourself

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: Current participant instructions and two attachment guidance files.
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet stops self-help for conditional/partial/ambiguous clemency, objections, victim/offense/charge uncertainty, citizenship and fee or installment arguments. It tells the participant to obtain and compare the Governor pardon and current AOC-RU-009 certification before filing.
